SELECT id AS semesterId, semester_code AS semesterCode, semester_name AS semesterName FROM semester dimension
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM course_offering o WHERE o.semester_id=dimension.id AND () )
ORDER BY semester_code, id

SELECT id AS collegeId, college_code AS collegeCode, college_name AS collegeName FROM college dimension
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM course_offering o WHERE o.source_scope_college_id=dimension.id AND () )
ORDER BY college_code, id

SELECT DISTINCT c.id AS collegeId, c.college_code AS collegeCode, c.college_name AS collegeName FROM college c JOIN course co ON co.owner_college_id=c.id JOIN course_offering o ON o.course_id=co.id WHERE () ORDER BY c.college_code, c.id

SELECT DISTINCT t.id AS teacherId, t.display_name AS displayName FROM teacher t JOIN schedule_teacher st ON st.teacher_id=t.id JOIN class_schedule cs ON cs.id=st.schedule_id JOIN course_offering o ON o.id=cs.offering_id WHERE () ORDER BY t.display_name, t.id
